summary.text: Farid Ishac is the Libertarian Party candidate on the November ballot for Michigan's 11th District. An automotive engineer, he describes himself as a Wayne State University alumnus running to show voters other choices.

paragraphs.text: Born in Livonia, Michigan; graduated from Detroit Catholic Central High School and earned degrees from Wayne State University, according to Ballotpedia.
Career experience includes working as an engineer; in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as an automotive engineer with 37 years of experience and a Wayne State MBA.
Nominated at the Libertarian Party convention on June 28, 2026.
